message:
Running command: # Compile standalone main
gcc -c -g -fsanitize=address \
  /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libfuzzer/standalone/StandaloneFuzzTargetMain.c \
  -o /workspace/standalone_main.o 2>&1

# Compile fuzz target wrapper
g++ -c -g -fsanitize=address -std=c++11 \
  -I /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib \
  /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/bin/fuzz/request_fuzzer.cc \
  -o /workspace/request_fuzzer.o 2>&1

# Link
g++ -g -fsanitize=address \
  /workspace/standalone_main.o \
  /workspace/request_fuzzer.o \
  /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lwan/src/lib/liblwan.a \
  -lpthread -lz \
  -o /workspace/request_fuzzer 2>&1
